description: This file contains unit tests for the PerformanceTrackerLogDao class within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It tests methods for retrieving performance tracker logs by ID, tracker ID, and rate counts.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PerformanceTrackerLogDao, verifying data retrieval methods related to performance tracker logs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DAO instance and loads test fixtures into the database.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceTrackerLogById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a performance tracker log by ID, asserting correct data for existing logs and null for non-existent IDs.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceTrackerLogsByTrackerId
methods.description: Verifies fetching logs by tracker ID, covering cases with existing logs, no logs, and non-existent tracker IDs.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceTrackerLogsRateCount
methods.description: Checks counting of positive and negative achievement logs by tracker ID, asserting expected counts.
